james-carter.name: James Carter
james-carter.bio: James Carter writes about companies, trade policy, manufacturing, and corporate strategy. His posts link to the public records and source material used for their central claims.

elena-vasquez.name: Elena Vasquez
elena-vasquez.bio: Elena Vasquez writes about markets, interest rates, household finance, and economic data. Her posts separate observed figures from forecasts and interpretation.

raj-patel.name: Raj Patel
raj-patel.bio: Raj Patel writes about international affairs, science, technology, and cross-border industry. His posts identify official claims and distinguish them from independently established facts.

sarah-kim.name: Sarah Kim
sarah-kim.bio: Sarah Kim writes about U.S. public health, medical research, science policy, education, and federal institutions. Her posts link to primary studies and regulator guidance where available.

maria-santos.name: Maria Santos
maria-santos.bio: Maria Santos writes about elections, courts, Congress, and public institutions. Her analysis labels projections and source attribution so readers can separate evidence from interpretation.

daniel-osei.name: Daniel Osei
daniel-osei.bio: Daniel Osei writes about major leagues, national teams, athlete performance, and the business of sport. Results and records are checked against league or governing-body data when available.
